common.error: Something went wrong. Could you try again?

auth.tagline: Widen the space between urge and action.
auth.noPassword: No password. Each time you sign in, a one-time code arrives in your inbox.
auth.codeHint: We sent a sign-in email to {email}. Tap the link in it on this device, or if it contains a {length}-digit code, enter it here.
auth.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Try again.
auth.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.linkFailed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new email and open the link in the same browser.
auth.accountDeleted: Your account and all your data have been deleted. You can start again with the same email anytime.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Widen the space between urge and action.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Open a short space the moment an urge arrives. Over time, learn from your own data what works for you.
onboarding.behaviorsTitle: What would you like to change?
onboarding.behaviorsHint: You can pick more than one.
onboarding.timingTitle: {count, plural, one {When does this usually happen?} other {When do these usually happen?}}
onboarding.timingHint: Optional. Over time PAUSE will learn this from your data.
onboarding.howTitle: What will PAUSE do for you?

how.urgeSub: You log it with one tap.
how.spaceSub: You don't have to decide right now.
how.learningSub: You see what works for you.

onboarding.safetyTitle: A short note before we begin
onboarding.safetyIntro: PAUSE is an awareness and self-regulation tool. It does not diagnose and is not a substitute for treatment.
onboarding.safetyAlcohol: Stopping alcohol suddenly can be medically risky for some people. If you plan to stop or cut down a lot, talk to a health professional first.
onboarding.safetyEating: We don't track calories, weight or portions. If your relationship with food feels hard, support from a professional can help.
onboarding.safetySupport: If you are in Türkiye: Yeşilay counselling line 115, emergencies 112.
onboarding.goalTitle: The goal isn't for urges to never come.
onboarding.goalBody: The goal is to have more choices when they do.

home.todayCounts: Today {urges, plural, one {# urge} other {# urges}} · {pauses, plural, one {# pause} other {# pauses}}
home.winAll: {total, plural, one {You made space before acting on today's urge.} other {You made space before acting on all # urges today.}}
home.winSome: You made space before acting on {paused} of {total} urges today.
home.winNone: Noticing and logging makes the first link of the chain visible.
home.emptyTitle: I'm here when an urge comes.
home.emptyBody: There is no right or wrong moment to log. Every moment you notice counts.
home.activePauseSub: When time is up, we'll check how you feel.
home.pauseEndedSub: Let's see how the urge is now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your name
settings.nameHint: Shown in the greeting on Home. You can leave it empty.
settings.feedbackHint: What was hard, what helped? Takes 2 minutes.
settings.analyticsHint: Helps us improve the app. Not linked to your account, contains no content.
settings.madeBy: PAUSE is a Peace Therapist app ·

urge.intensityTitle: How strong is the urge right now?
urge.pauseTitle: You don't have to decide now.
urge.emotionsTitle: What are you feeling right now?
urge.emotionsHint: Just naming it can soften the urge a little.
urge.multiHint: You can pick more than one.
urge.addFailed: Couldn't add it. Check your internet connection.
urge.pickHint: Something small is enough. We'll check how you feel afterwards.
urge.waitingSub: When time is up, we'll look at how you feel together.
urge.changeUpSub: That's worth knowing. Next time you could try a different option.
urge.dataBody: Moments when the behavior happens also help us understand what works for you.
urge.dataLater: If you like, we can look at what happened together now. It takes about 2 minutes.
urge.sosBeforeTitle: How strong was the urge at the start?
urge.saveError: Couldn't save. Could you try again?
urge.reviewOffline: The entry hasn't been sent yet. Once you're online you can review it from History.
urge.suggestedPlan: The plan you chose for yourself last time
urge.suggestedWorked: With {trigger}, your urge dropped by {value} points on average

changePlace.l1: Get up from where you are.

urgeSurf.title: Observe the urge
urgeSurf.body: Urges are like waves. They rise, peak and fall.
urgeSurf.hint: Don't try to change it; just watch.

simple.move: Get up and walk or stretch for two minutes.
simple.reach_out: Send someone a short message or call. You don't have to explain how you feel.
simple.music: Put on a song you like and listen to the end.
simple.relax_muscles: Squeeze your hands for five seconds, then let go. Raise your shoulders, let go. Repeat three times.
simple.just_wait: Wait without doing anything. Just notice the urge.
simple.custom: Try your own option. Tap when you're done.

outcome.stopped_early: I did it but stopped early.

soon.title: This screen is coming in the next step
soon.body: The urge flow is the next Phase 1 module.

history.title: History
history.daySummary: {urges, plural, one {# urge} other {# urges}} · {pauses, plural, one {# pause} other {# pauses}}
history.emptyBody: When an urge comes, tap the button on Home. You can also add moments afterwards when you couldn't open the app.
history.pending: {count, plural, one {# entry will be sent when you're back online.} other {# entries will be sent when you're back online.}}
history.notesPlaceholder: What did you go through, what did you notice? What would you like to tell yourself next time?
history.deleteConfirm: This entry will be permanently deleted.
history.offlineError: Couldn't save. Check your internet connection and try again.
history.notePrivate: Your notes are visible only to you.

retro.whenHint: Moments when you couldn't open the app are data too.

notify.promptTitle: Should I let you know when time is up?
notify.promptBody: Even if you close the app, you'll get a short notification when the 10 minutes are over. It never names the behavior.
notify.installTitle: Add to Home Screen for notifications
notify.installBody: On iPhone, notifications only work in the app added to the Home Screen: in Safari tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
notify.error: Couldn't turn on notifications. Refresh the page and try again.
notify.settingTitle: Notify me when time is up

state.needs-install: On iPhone, add to Home Screen first

notify.testSent: Sent. It should arrive within a few seconds.
notify.testMissing: No notification subscription is saved for this account. Turn notifications off and on again.
notify.testFailed: Couldn't send the test notification. Try again in a moment.

behaviorSettings.pauseHint: How much space should open when an urge comes?
behaviorSettings.whyLabel: Why do I want to change?
behaviorSettings.whyHint: To remind yourself in hard moments.
behaviorSettings.whyPlaceholder: e.g. I want to wake up feeling fresher
behaviorSettings.archiveConfirm: This behavior will leave your list. Your past entries stay; if you add it again, they come back.
behaviorSettings.lastActive: You need to track at least one behavior. Add another one first.
behaviorSettings.costLabel: How much do you spend on average each time?
behaviorSettings.costHint: When an urge comes and you don't act on it, this amount counts as not spent. E.g. if a pack costs 100 and you smoke 1 cigarette each time, enter 5.

account.exportCsv: Download my entries as a table
account.exportCsvHint: CSV · opens in Excel or Numbers
account.deleteTitle: Your account will be permanently deleted
account.deleteBody: Your behaviors, all entries, feedback and notification subscriptions will be deleted. This can't be undone. You may want to download your data first.
account.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the account. Check your connection and try again.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: We're shaping PAUSE together. Answer any questions you like; all are optional.

q.wish: What would you like us to add?

feedback.screenshotHint: Up to 5 MB. Only the team sees it.
feedback.tooLarge: The image is larger than 5 MB.
feedback.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the image. Try sending without it.
feedback.thanksBody: Your feedback reached us. We read every answer.

reflect.cutHere: I could have cut it here
reflect.introTitle: Let's look at the chain together.
reflect.introBody: Not to blame yourself; to see where you could open up some space next time.
reflect.thoughtTitle: What was going through your mind?
reflect.thoughtHint: One sentence is enough. Skip it if you don't remember.
reflect.actionTitle: What was the first small step in the chain?
reflect.actionHint: The moment right before the behavior itself: often the easiest place to cut.
reflect.actionPlaceholder: E.g. I picked up my phone, I walked to the shop
reflect.cutTitle: Where could you have cut the chain?
reflect.cutHint: Tap a link. The earliest point isn't always the easiest; pick the one that feels realistic.
reflect.nextTitle: When that moment comes, what will we try?
reflect.nextHint: Pick an alternative for the "{step}" moment.
reflect.saveError: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
reflect.doneBody: You'll see it at the top of your alternatives during your next urge.
reflect.reminderTitle: Want to look at the chain?
reflect.reminderBody: Review your last entry in 2 minutes and pick a plan.

insights.title: Insights
insights.emptyBody: As you log urges, your own patterns will show up here. You can also try a longer period.
insights.firstTitle: Your first insights are on the way
insights.firstBody: Patterns become clear after a few entries. For now you can see what you've logged below.

summary.title: In this period
summary.urges: {count, plural, one {You logged # urge} other {You logged # urges}}
summary.stoppedEarly: {count, plural, one {You stopped early once after starting.} other {You stopped early # times after starting.}}

triggers.intensity: Urges linked to {trigger} started at an average intensity of {avg}.
triggers.empty: Triggers you pick while logging urges will show up here.

time.title: When?
time.headline: You logged the most urges between {from} and {to}.
time.notEnough: Your time pattern becomes clear after {min} entries.

works.noDropYet: No alternative shows a clear drop yet. Keep experimenting; every measurement sharpens the picture.

works.empty: Alternatives you try during a pause will show up here.
works.note: Change: intensity after the pause minus before. Not a claim of cause and effect.

pairs.title: What works when?
pairs.locked: Once you've tried the same alternative with the same trigger at least {min} times, your personal matches will appear here.

insights.mapCardSub: Your trigger, risky hours, strongest alternative
insights.savingsCardSub: Money you didn't spend, lessons from what happened

review.countZeroBody: That's okay. Noticing an urge and logging it is already a step.
review.hardestDayBody: {count, plural, one {# urge.} other {# urges.}} Knowing this ahead of time helps you prepare.

review.pausedZeroBody: Trying it even once next week means new data.
review.worked: When you tried {label}, your urge dropped by {value} points on average.
review.workedBody: {count} measurements. Not a claim of cause and effect; it's what your data shows.

progress.avgChange: Your urge dropped more after pausing.

review.experimentTitle: Try one thing for a week.
review.experimentBody: Your own data will show the result.
review.cardBody: {count, plural, one {Page through last week's entry.} other {Page through last week's # entries.}}

experiment.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {Last day} other {# days left}}
experiment.noCausality: Change: average difference in urge before and after the pause. Not a claim of cause and effect.
experiment.waiting: When an urge matches the rule, this experiment will appear at the top of your alternatives.
experiment.emptyBody: Try a single alternative in a specific situation for a week, and let your own data show whether it helps.
experiment.endConfirm: The experiment will end. Results so far are kept.
experiment.saveError: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
experiment.triggerHint: Pick the trigger the experiment applies to.
experiment.interventionHint: One alternative for the whole week.
experiment.thresholdHint: Limiting it to strong urges makes the experiment clearer.
experiment.thresholdMin: When the urge is {value} or more
experiment.confirmHint: For 7 days, this alternative will appear at the top for every urge that matches the rule.
experiment.replaceWarning: Your current experiment will end and this one will start instead.

map.title: Your behavior map
map.lockedBody: Your personal behavior map opens after {min} entries. Each entry adds a new point to it.
map.intro: The picture from your {count} entries. It updates as you add more.
map.alternativeHint: Appears once an alternative has been tried and measured at least 5 times.
map.cutPoint: Where you could most often cut the chain
map.cutPointHint: Comes from the chain reviews you do when a behavior happens.
map.growthSub: Last 30 days compared with the 30 before
map.growthHint: Appears once there are enough entries in two separate periods.

growthAreas.pauseRate: Putting space between urge and behavior
growthAreas.avgChange: Your urge dropping after a pause

map.note: This isn't a diagnosis; it's only the patterns in your own entries.

milestones.title: Your milestones
milestones.intro: No streaks, no resets. Each milestone marks a step in learning; none of them is taken back, even when a behavior happens.
milestones.note: Milestones are calculated from your entries. If you delete an entry, a related milestone may change.

first_urge.title: You logged your first urge.
first_urge.body: The first link of the chain is now visible.
first_urge.hint: Log an urge when it comes.

first_pause.title: You waited out a full pause for the first time.
first_pause.body: You put deliberate space between the urge and the behavior.
first_pause.hint: Keep a pause going until time is up and re-measure the urge.

first_alternative.title: You tried an alternative during an urge for the first time.
first_alternative.body: You tried a new response instead of the automatic one.
first_alternative.hint: Finish an alternative during a pause.

first_stopped_early.title: You stopped early after starting, for the first time.
first_stopped_early.body: Cutting the chain halfway is a skill too.
first_stopped_early.hint: Log a moment when you were able to stop after starting.

ten_events.title: You've collected data from 10 different moments.
ten_events.body: Your own patterns are starting to show.

first_review.title: You did your first chain review.
first_review.body: Looking at what happened without blame changes the next time.
first_review.hint: Review the chain when a behavior happens.

first_pattern.title: Your first personal pattern appeared.
first_pattern.body: You can now see in your own data how an alternative works for you.
first_pattern.hint: Try one alternative 5 times and measure after the pause.

first_experiment.title: You completed your first personal experiment.
first_experiment.body: A week-long experiment's result is now your data.
first_experiment.hint: Keep a weekly experiment going to the end.
